person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Theodore R Coverly in Box 149 without a rank and without a complete eight-character identifier. The Army merged file contains one exact-name row, but no second identifier links it to the OSS record; official, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory and web checks produced no reliable bridge.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 for full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and chronology; do not transfer the name-only Army record without corroboration.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Floyd R Covey in Box 149 with a short printed identifier. The Army merged file contains no exact-name row and the short identifier cannot support an exact comparison; no reliable official, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory or archival source established identity or a pre-OSS affiliation.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 and resolve the short printed identifier before assigning a military record, occupation or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives John W Covill in Box 149 without a rank or private identifier. A person of that exact name appears in a wartime USAAF prisoner-of-war derivative, and an unofficial microfilm name list supplies only an OSS association, but neither source bridges the Box 149 person or reconciles the chronology. The identity remains unresolved.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 to establish whether the indexed person is the USAAF prisoner-of-war namesake and to document any Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Richard L Covington in Box 149 without a rank or private identifier. person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 for a second identifier before transferring the name-only Army record, its occupation code or any affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Richard O Covington in Box 149 without a rank or private identifier. A Southern Tennis Foundation biography for Richard O. Covington Jr. documents a plausible wartime namesake but supplies no OSS, Box 149 or second-identifier bridge, so no identity or affiliation was adopted.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 before deciding whether the indexed person is the tennis biography namesake.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Catherine Cowan in Box 149 without a middle initial, rank or private identifier. A 1930 institutional source names a Catherine Cowan who planned to teach after St. Lawrence University, but the common name and absence of an OSS or Box 149 bridge make the result insufficient.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 for middle name, birth or residence data before revisiting institutional namesakes.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives George L Cowan in Box 149 with a short printed identifier. The Army merged file contains one exact-name row, but the short identifier cannot establish a match and no second identifier or OSS bridge was found; patent and biographical results were unlinked namesakes.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 and resolve the short printed identifier before transferring the name-only Army record or any namesake affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives John K Cowan in Box 149 with a seven-digit printed identifier. The Army merged file contains one exact-name row with a damaged grade field, but no exact identifier comparison or second identifier is available. Five Library of Congress newspaper candidates were reviewed and rejected as a deceased pre-1908 namesake, John C Cowan, or funeral-home references to John J Cowan Son.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 to recover the complete identifier and adjudicate the name-only Army record; do not infer a grade from its damaged field.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Joseph G Cowel in Box 149 without a rank or private identifier. No exact-name Army row or reliable official, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory or archival source established identity or a pre-OSS affiliation; similarly spelled Cowell results were not treated as corrections.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 149 for full identity and determine whether Cowel is the controlling spelling before testing variants.
